meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Browse the web for any task — research topics, read articles, interact with web apps, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, and test web pages. Use whenever a browser would be useful, not just when the user explicitly asks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用浏览器自动完成网页浏览、数据提取和测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器完成各种网页任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate web browsing, data extraction, and testing with a browser
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to programmatically control a browser for web tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以自动打开网页、点击按钮、填写表单、截图、提取文字和数据，还能保存登录状态。
howto.when: 当你需要查资料、填表单、截图或测试网页时，Claude 会自动使用浏览器，无需你明确要求。

say.text: 帮我打开百度首页，截图给我看。
say.note: Claude 会打开百度并截图保存。

say.text: 搜索今天的新闻，提取前三条标题。
say.note: Claude 会打开搜索引擎，提取结果。

say.text: 登录我的邮箱，检查是否有新邮件。
say.note: 需要先保存登录状态，Claude 会加载状态后操作。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can open web pages, click buttons, fill forms, take screenshots, extract text and data, and save login states.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to research, fill forms, take screenshots, or test web pages; Claude will use the browser automatically without explicit request.

say_en.text: Open Baidu homepage and take a screenshot for me.
say_en.note: Claude will open Baidu and save a screenshot.

say_en.text: Search today's news and extract the top three headlines.
say_en.note: Claude will open a search engine and extract results.

say_en.text: Log into my email and check for new messages.
say_en.note: Requires saved login state; Claude will load state and proceed.
